# ledger_bucket_member (Resource)

A commitment or account in a bucket. Buckets group commitments and accounts only, and hold no money. The bucket must be active to add a member; removing a member is allowed from an archived bucket too.

Import with `<bucket_id>/<object_type>/<object_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ledger_bucket_member" "rent" {
  bucket_id   = ledger_bucket.fixed_costs.id
  object_type = "commitment"
  object_id   = "01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA" # a commitment identifier
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_id` (String) The identifier of the bucket. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `object_id` (String) The Ledger identifier of the commitment or account. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `object_type` (String) The kind of object: `commitment` or `account`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) When it was added (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) `<bucket_id>/<object_type>/<object_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <bucket_id>/<object_type>/<object_id>
terraform import ledger_bucket_member.rent 01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNA/commitment/01JD3Y4C8V9M2Q7W5R6T0XZBNB
```
